data.notes: Only a small number of December 2026 listings are confirmed this far out, with the strongest verified activity clustering around a major stadium concert and New Year’s Eve parties.

events.title: Xuxa — O Último Voo da Nave
events.summary: Xuxa brings the stadium-scale “O Último Voo da Nave” show to Maracanã on 20 December 2026 at 19:00, with the event page listing 30e as promoter and tickets via Eventim.

events.title: Réveillon Maravilha 2027 com Belo

events.title: Réveillon Tropical 2027
